hints.title: Use the axes as exact tests
hints.body: On the horizontal axis the vertical coordinate is zero; on the vertical axis the horizontal coordinate is zero. Substitute these values separately into the given equation.
hints.recap: Axis intersections give exact landmarks without solving for the whole curve.
hints.pitfall: A sketch must pass both tests, not just one.
hints.pause: Find the two intercepts and compare them with every sketch.

recall.reminder: Choose inputs that remove terms and make an identity easy to use.

solution:
Putting y=0 gives x3=1, so the only x-intercept is (1,0). Putting x=0 gives the only y-intercept (0,1).

Only C has these intercepts. Also (x+y)(x2−xy+y2)=x3+y3, which confirms that y decreases as x increases. Answer C.
knowledgePattern: Use intercepts to discriminate implicit graph options
